services.name: Salsa Dance Team
services.desc: Classic? Casual? Crazy? We’ll help you create a first dance that’s just your style. Our 30-minute free consultation is a chance for you to see our studio and talk with an instructor about your vision for your first dance. If you haven’t chosen your song yet, bring options that you’re considering to the consultation so you can discuss possibilities with your instructor. Need song ideas? See here. From elegant simplicity with a picture perfect ending, to an epic dance that will amaze your family and friends, we will help you create the first dance of your dreams! Private lessons and custom group classes available for Father/Daughter and Mother/Son dances, plus the whole wedding party! All
